# Sequential Probability Ratio Test (SPRT)

**Source:** [`26-sequential-analysis-1/slides.html`](https://github.com/berkeley-stat158/spring-2026/blob/3863c023585286c55df692b83ee6cd5c56dbe822/26-sequential-analysis-1/slides.html) · **Licence:** unresolved · Converted 2026-09-14 from `.html` (good)

## Parameters

``` {.sourceCode .numberSource .r .number-lines .code-with-copy}
p0 <- 0.05     # acceptable defect rate under H0
p1 <- 0.15     # unacceptable defect rate under H1
alpha <- 0.05
beta  <- 0.10
n_max   <- 200        # max sample size allowed
```

## Simulate one run of the SPRT

``` {.sourceCode .numberSource .r .number-lines .code-with-copy}
set.seed(3405)
y <- rbinom(n_max, size = 1, prob = p1)  # simulate data under H1
y
```

``` {.sourceCode .numberSource .r .number-lines .code-with-copy}
log_lr <- cumsum(
    y * log(p1 / p0) +
     (1 - y) * log((1 - p1) / (1 - p0))
)
log_lr
```
